Gen. Fred C. Weyand

Project 51 · Joint Chiefs of Staff, Army Chief of Staff, from templates-jcs/weyand.json · index · repo randomcase/gen-fred-c-weyand

Army Chief of Staff · 1974–1976 · at the fall, 1975-04-30

Army Chief on the fall date, and the last commander of MACV. Flew to Saigon in late March 1975 at Ford’s order, returned 4 April, and reported that without $722 million in aid the South would fall. Congress said no. He was right on the date to within weeks.

The office

The Joint Staff, the Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia. The Chairman’s office is on the E-ring, second floor, river side; the Chiefs meet in the “Tank”, Room 2E924, and from 1972 in the Gold Room next to it.
